grenadestat.def: A temporary bonus to the Grenade stat (faster grenade recharge), e.g. from Grenade Font while you have Armor Charge.
grenadestat.q: You gain a bonus to your grenade stat while you have any Armor Charge.

meleestat.def: A temporary bonus to the Melee stat (faster melee recharge), e.g. from Melee Font while you have Armor Charge.
meleestat.q: Grants 20|40|50 Melee stat with 1|2|3 Mods equipped while you have active Armor Charges.

classstat.def: A temporary bonus to the Class stat (faster class ability recharge), e.g. from Class Font while you have Armor Charge.
classstat.q: Grants 20|40|50 Class stat with 1|2|3 Mods equipped while you have active Armor Charges.

superstat.def: A temporary bonus to the Super stat (faster Super energy gain), e.g. from Super Font while you have Armor Charge.
superstat.q: Grants 20|40|50 Super stat with 1|2|3 Mods equipped while you have active Armor Charges.

weaponsstat.def: A temporary bonus to the Weapons stat (weapon damage and handling), e.g. from Weapons Font while you have Armor Charge.
weaponsstat.q: You gain a bonus to your weapons stat while you have any Armor Charge.
